newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks edge up, subdued by low liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks edge up, subdued by low liquidity.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were slightly firmer on low turnover in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
The all share index was 1.66 points up at 630.6 at the mid-morning break. Lion Brewery, which began trading today, was 4.50 rupees up at 24.50. Hayleys rose four rupees to 190.
"There are buyers looking for quantities of selected stocks. If such quantities can be sourced, final turnover should rise considerably," said Shanil Perera, broker at Lanka Securities.
